Mahi-Mahi Fishing Report – San José del Cabo, August 2026

Fishing Report Aug 2 Written by EXOTIC FISH-CABO

Brooke's Mahi-Mahi Catch – An Offshore Fishing Experience

On August 2, 2026, Brooke and her husband Matt joined Exotic Fish Cabo for a private offshore fishing charter departing from Puerto Los Cabos Marina in San José del Cabo.

Their morning turned into a memorable fishing experience when Brooke hooked a beautiful mahi-mahi, also known as dorado, while trolling in offshore waters.

After the strike, the fish made several powerful runs. Brooke worked to maintain steady pressure while Matt encouraged her throughout the fight.

With assistance from the crew, she successfully brought the mahi-mahi aboard. Its distinctive blue, green, and golden colors made the moment even more memorable.

For Brooke and Matt, the highlight was not simply catching a fish. It was sharing an exciting experience together on the waters of Los Cabos.

Offshore Trolling for Mahi-Mahi in San José del Cabo

Trolling is a common technique for targeting mahi-mahi in the offshore waters around San José del Cabo.

By moving fishing lines through productive areas, anglers can cover water while searching for actively feeding fish.

Mahi-mahi are known for their speed, striking colors, and energetic fights. They often respond aggressively when feeding, but successfully landing one still requires patience and proper rod control.

Brooke's catch illustrates an important part of offshore fishing: an initial strike is only the beginning. Maintaining consistent line pressure and responding carefully to a fish's changes in direction can make a significant difference during the fight.

What Anglers Should Know About August Mahi-Mahi Fishing

August is part of the warm-water fishing season in Los Cabos, when mahi-mahi may be encountered in offshore waters.

Their location and activity can change with water temperature, currents, floating debris, and the availability of baitfish.

For anglers planning a summer fishing charter, three practical considerations are especially useful:

  • Fishing conditions: Offshore water clarity, currents, and bait activity can influence where fish are found.

  • Fishing technique: Trolling is one option for covering offshore water and searching for active mahi-mahi.

  • Realistic expectations: A successful catch on one charter does not predict what will happen on another day.

Every fishing trip is different, and catches are never guaranteed.

Trip Highlights

  • Date: August 2, 2026

  • Departure: Puerto Los Cabos Marina, San José del Cabo

  • Guests: Brooke and Matt

  • Angler: Brooke

  • Species caught: Mahi-mahi (dorado)

  • Fishing technique: Offshore trolling

  • Fishing area: Offshore waters near San José del Cabo

  • Highlight: Brooke successfully landed a colorful mahi-mahi after several strong runs

  • Experience: Private offshore fishing charter
